general_notes: I read each text for process (washed / natural / wet-hull / anaerobic / co-ferment / robusta blend) and for explicit cup words: acidity level, body, sweetness, flavour family, fermented character, and the roaster's framing ('без лишней кислотности', 'яркий', 'на каждый день'). Process and the roaster's own acidity wording were the strongest signals. Hard parts: (1) Колумбия Декаф has no cup description at all, so I never chose it. (2) Колумбия Эль Пласэр ИПА, Q-Finch and Колумбия Антиокия say little about the cup, so picks built on them are lower confidence. (3) Индонезия Мерури (wet-hull, spicy) and Колумбия Ла Сирена (co-ferment strawberry) have no real twins, so their neighbours are partial matches. (4) The roaster's adjectives are inflated ('яркий' appears even in calm blends such as Q-Profit), so I weighted process and explicit acidity statements over generic praise. (5) The low-acid end (Q-Punch, Мерури) and the high-acid end (Найваша) have no clear further step, hence 'none' there.
